title: Handedness in Children – Reviewing the Assessment as Part of the School Entry Examination
summary:
Background
In many federal states, children's future writing hand is determined during the school entry examination (SEE) through a simple question about their dominant hand. If the non-preferred hand is chosen, this can have a number of far-reaching consequences.
Research question
The aim of the study is to determine handedness more accurately during the SEU. 
Methodology
The more accurate method of determining handedness involved a questionnaire for parents to complete about the handedness of their child and their relatives, as well as their preferences for the left or right hand (or foot) in everyday activities (e.g. painting, brushing teeth, throwing). This was supplemented by structured observations and documentation by nursing staff and doctors. For children with unclear handedness, comprehensive testing by certified experts was offered.

interventions.name: As part of the school entrance examination, children and their parents are asked additional questions focusing on handedness, and the examiners carry out and document structured observations.
